hooks.command: if command -v brot >/dev/null 2>&1; then brot hook codex session-start; fi
if command -v brot >/dev/null 2>&1; then brot hook codex session-end; fi
if command -v brot >/dev/null 2>&1; then brot hook codex pre-tool; fi
if command -v brot >/dev/null 2>&1; then brot hook codex post-tool-use; fi
if command -v brot >/dev/null 2>&1; then brot hook codex subagent-start; fi
if command -v brot >/dev/null 2>&1; then brot hook codex subagent-stop; fi
if command -v brot >/dev/null 2>&1; then brot hook codex post-compact; fi
